name: cold-radar
subject: A coverage radar for {{outlet}}
textbody:
Dear {{name}},

Your team reports stories others miss — that's the hard part of journalism.

The easy part — covering the daily news cycle — can be automated.

My engine scans thousands of sources daily, finds what's trending, and publishes sourced, SEO-ready articles in your brand, 24/7. Your reporters get a daily coverage-gap report and stay focused on the stories only they can do.

Human approval before anything publishes. 15 minutes to see it live?{{unsubscribe}}
